decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the external e-paper backlight as a 5V-rail load and its approximately 70mA worst-case current; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.
J_DISP_LED is a separate non-addressable e-paper backlight circuit; its selectable 5V or fallback 3.3V supply does not change the SK6812 addressable-LED interface.
The DNP series-resistor footprint in the source is part of the backlight power output, not the SDA/SCL series-resistor and pull-up network.
The external e-paper backlight is independent of the eight-SK6812 daughterboard and does not change its LED count, part, package, or board form.
The current build uses the 5V backlight jumper, while the 3.3V footprint is only an unpopulated fallback; the source does not require the standalone USB 3.3V supply to power the backlight.
The monitor already covers the complete 5V rail, so adding a backlight load to that rail does not change the monitored rails, monitor topology, or device requirement.
The BSS138 in the source is a low-side PWM power switch for the backlight, not a sensor logic-level shifter, and does not affect sensor compatibility.
The power-path state already requires both 3.3V and 5V rails and covers all system loads; the backlight circuit does not alter the AXP2101 battery or system power-path behavior.
J_DISP_LED is a display-backlight interface and does not change the inventory or consolidation policy for external sensor connectors.
GPIO42 PWM is an internal backlight-control signal and the source does not add, remove, or alter any panel-mounted control connector.
The populated backlight configuration uses 5V; the unpopulated 3.3V fallback does not change DCDC1's programmed voltage, regulation behavior, or current role.
The backlight connector, PWM switch, and supply-selection details do not affect USB enumeration, data routing, connector selection, or flashing behavior.
